subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Can We Unwatch?
description: A micro-lesson that makes Can We Unwatch? usable.

hook.text: Is it possible to roll back surveillance, or have we crossed a point of no return?

buildup.text: Every year, surveillance expands: more cameras, more sensors, more data, fewer blind spots.

discovery.text: Some victories exist: GDPR, facial recognition bans, and encrypted messaging reaching billions.

twist.text: But technology moves faster than law. AI advances outpace every regulation written to contain it.

climax.text: Unwatching requires constant effort: better laws, better tools, and citizens who refuse to accept it.

punchline.text: We can push back. But we can never stop pushing.

quiz.question: What is needed to push back against expanding surveillance?
options: Better laws, better tools, and active citizen engagement
Only new technology can solve the problem
